description: Bring a region from a neighbouring screenshot of the same screen to a fixed position. Use when copy_from_neighbour's auto alignment picks the wrong spot: measure an anchor in both shots (find --text ... --button), then at = region top-left + (target anchor - donor anchor).

inputs.donor: neighbouring screenshot that shows the wanted state
inputs.region: x0,y0,x1,y1 of the area in the DONOR
inputs.x: target x of the region's top-left
inputs.y: target y of the region's top-left
